text:
jordan: FYI opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4523 — refactor: move GKE service account binding into modules/gke, small API change to module inputs, and bumped google provider to allow api keyring access. Need a quick staging plan check before I merge.

devops-bot: CI started: terraform/plan (staging) · job 12

mai: CI is failing with a provider mismatch error: "provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/google: required 4.59.0, but 4.57.0 is locked". looks like the module bump changed constraints but .terraform.lock.hcl at repo root wasn't updated.

kyle: For module-level changes we generally add a required_providers block inside the module and then regenerate the top-level lockfile from repo root. Avoid pinning provider versions in root unless absolutely necessary.

jordan: i added this in modules/gke/main.tf:

```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    google = {
      source  = "hashicorp/google"
      version = ">= 4.59.0"
    }
  }
}
```

but CI still fails even after running `terraform init` locally — maybe I'm missing a step to update the lockfile for the CI platform.

olivia: CI runs init from repo root with `-backend-config` and a linux amd64 runner. You need to run from the repo root and regenerate the lockfile for the same platform grp. Try:

```bash
# from repo root
terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64
git add .terraform.lock.hcl
git commit -m "regen lockfile after google provider bump"
```

Also check the CI terraform version; older TF can interpret lockfile differences badly.

jordan: thanks. also seeing a plan warning about KMS access for the SA — do we want to add an IAM binding here or move to a global iam module? i can add a temporary binding if needed to get the rollout done.

mai: keep changes minimal in this PR. add the least-privileged `google_project_iam_member` in the gke module with a comment TODO pointing to migrating to the iam module. that avoids churn in other stacks during the rollout.

kyle: pinging @olivia for a quick CI runtime bump if needed — we've had flaky plan jobs when TF version mismatches the lockfile algorithm.

olivia: i'll bump the CI image to terraform 1.5.8 and re-run the plan. should be quick. :white_check_mark:

jordan: done — pushed updated .terraform.lock.hcl and a tiny IAM resource. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4523/files

devops-bot: CI update: terraform/plan (staging) rerun started

devops-bot: CI success: terraform/plan (staging) · job 12 — no changes (only comment and lockfile). :tada:

mai: nice — LGTM from infra side. kyle/olivia, any objections before jordan merges?

kyle: nope, go ahead — just follow up with a ticket to move the IAM binding to the central iam module.

olivia: agree. also opened CHORE-678 to track TF version pinning in CI images.

jordan: will merge and file the followups. thanks all!
